data.exact_reserve_text: The 2014 net technical result of GBP 42.4m (2013: GBP 49.1m) includes GBP 27.7m (2013: GBP 39.9m) of releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years.

prior_year_events.impact_description: A previously noted large loss; the Syndicate's conservative reserving meant continued deterioration did not adversely affect the Syndicate's net position.

named_events.loss_description: The tragic loss of the "Costa Concordia" was noted in the 2012 report; conservative reserving limited adverse effect on net position.
Horrific loss of Malaysian Airlines flight MH17 over the Ukraine had a significant impact on the Syndicate's aviation war portfolio but the net effect was moderated by reinsurance.
Prolonged attack on Tripoli airport in Libya had a significant impact on the Syndicate's aviation war portfolio but net effect was moderated by reinsurance.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2014 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 526.3m. During 2014 the Syndicate reported net releases of GBP 27.7m in respect of prior accident years (around a 5.3% release relative to opening gross reserves). The report attributes these movements to favourable claims development and the effect of reinsurance recoveries. The year also saw significant current-year aviation losses (eg. MH17 and the Tripoli airport attack) which were largely moderated by the reinsurance programme. No explicit gross prior-year-only movement was published, so the reported net prior-year release has been used.
raw_causal_phrases: includes GBP 27.7m (2013: GBP 39.9m) of releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years.
These losses had a significant impact on the Syndicate's aviation war portfolio, however the net effect on the portfolio was moderated to acceptable levels by the Syndicate's reinsurance programme.

The tragic loss of the "Costa Concordia" was noted in the 2012 report. The Syndicate's conservative approach to reserving has meant that continued deterioration of this loss in financial terms has not adversely affected the Syndicate's net position.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding GBP 526,330k at 1 Jan 2014). The report explicitly states a NET release of GBP 27.7m for prior accident years; no explicit GROSS prior-year-only movement figure was presented. A gross 'Change in claims outstanding' figure for the year is shown in the technical provisions reconciliation but that represents total gross movement during the year and is not labelled as prior-year development. No gross claims development triangle was found. Prior-year development figure used is NET of reinsurance as explicitly stated in the notes - flagged as a net figure because no gross PYD was available.
